title: error document
description: The one failure document of the handoff convention: every --json failure of tools/apply.py (with stages, or under --contract frames/2), sapphire and tools/handoff.py. A tool may add keys next to error (verify and doctor add checks). x-codes is the one error table: the code, the exit status of a wrapper under frames/1 and frames/2, and when the code is used. Identical in every repository that follows the convention.

ok.description: Always false in an error document.

contract.description: The contract the tool spoke for this run.

stage.description: Label of the failing step (decode, pre1, vfx, effect, post1, encode, verify, layer-decode, args, a handoff.py subcommand, replay, lock), or null when the failure belongs to no step.

exit_code.description: Exit status of the failing child process (a stage, ffmpeg, ffprobe, a replayed command), or null when no child failed. The tool's own exit status follows from code through x-codes.

stderr_tail.description: Last lines of the failing child's standard error, oldest first, at most 5.

x-codes.when: a process exited non zero outside the exits 2, 3 and 4 of a stage, a layer decode failed, or the output did not verify or could not be moved into place
a bad flag or flag combination, an unknown placeholder value, or a stage that exited 2

a valid request the tool refuses: a stage that exited 3, an unknown effect, HDR input, an odd side without --lossless, an unknown geometry value, an fps change by a declared stage, a replay of an unregistered program
an input that is missing, unreadable or malformed, a stage that exited 4, an invalid packet, a hash or expectation mismatch, a revision conflict
a stage stopped reading its input, or exited 0 after writing fewer whole frames than it was sent
a producer's output ended inside a frame, or a file is not a whole number of frames
no byte moved on a judged process's pipes for --stage-timeout seconds (decode, pre and post stages, encode; vfx is not judged), a replayed command ran past its limit, or a packet lock stayed held
a program (ffmpeg, ffprobe, vfx, sapphire, a stage program) or a peer repository cannot be found or started
the run was interrupted (Ctrl+C); produced by tools/apply.py and tools/handoff.py, not by sapphire

x-frames1-exits.when: any refusal or failure, whatever the code
the argument parser rejected the command line

x-stage-exits.when: every input frame was processed and written
the stage rejected its command line
the stage refuses the request (effect, parameter, depth, geometry)
the stage could not read its input or a layer, or the input ended inside a frame
any other non zero status, a crash or a kill

error.message: pre-stage 1 moved no byte for 120 seconds and was killed
